questions.question: Q1(h). Find √((1 + i)/(1 - i)).
questions.solution: (1+i)/(1-i) = (1+i)²/2 = 2i/2 = i. √i: x²-y² = 0, 2xy = 1, x²+y² = 1 → x = y = 1/√2. Boxed 1/√2+i/√2 (matches the printed key).

questions.question: Q2. If z = 2 - 3i and w = 3 - 2i, show that z̄^2 + w̄^2 = 0.
questions.solution: z̄ = 2+3i, z̄² = 4+12i+9i² = -5+12i. w̄ = 3+2i, w̄² = 9+12i+4i² = 5+12i. Sum: -5+12i+5-12i = 0. ∎ (matches the printed key value 0).

questions.question: Q5. Prove that z̄/|z|^2 is the multiplicative inverse of z.
questions.solution: z·(z̄/|z|²) = (z·z̄)/|z|² = |z|²/|z|² = 1 (for z ≠ 0). So z̄/|z|² is the inverse of z. ∎ (proof-type; no key answer needed).

questions.question: Q6(d). If x - iy = √((1 - i)/(1 + i)), prove that x^2 + y^2 = 1.
questions.solution: x²+y² = |x-iy|² = |(1-i)/(1+i)| = |1-i|/|1+i| = √2/√2 = 1. ∎ (the square root only takes a modulus-1 number to a modulus-1 number).

questions.question: Q7. If z and w are two complex numbers, prove that |z + w|^2 = |z|^2 + |w|^2 + 2Re(zw̄).
questions.solution: |z+w|² = (z+w)(z̄+w̄) = zz̄ + ww̄ + zw̄ + z̄w = |z|²+|w|²+(zw̄ + (zw̄)-bar) = |z|²+|w|²+2Re(zw̄). ∎ (proof-type; no key answer needed).

questions.question: Q9. If z and w are two complex numbers, prove that |z - w| ≥ |z| - |w|.
questions.solution: |z-w|² = |z|²+|w|²-2Re(zw̄) ≥ |z|²+|w|²-2|zw̄| = |z|²+|w|²-2|z||w| = (|z|-|w|)². Taking square roots: |z-w| ≥ ||z|-|w|| ≥ |z|-|w|. ∎ (proof-type; no key answer needed).

questions.question: Q10(a). Determine the square roots of 5 + 12i. (T.U. 2051)
questions.solution: Let √(5+12i) = x+iy: x²-y² = 5, 2xy = 12, x²+y² = |5+12i| = 13. Adding: 2x² = 18, x = ±3; then y = ±2 (same sign, since xy = 6 > 0). Boxed ±(3+2i) (matches the printed key).
questions.source: Sukunda Basic Mathematics Grade XI, Ch.11 Ex 11.2 Q10(a) (T.U. 2051); book p329 = PDF p356 (vision read)

questions.knowledgeNote: Norm is still 13; signs: x²-y² = -5 gives x = ±2, and xy > 0 keeps signs together.
questions.question: Q10(b). Determine the square roots of -5 + 12i.
questions.solution: x²-y² = -5, 2xy = 12, x²+y² = 13 → 2x² = 8, x = ±2, y = ±3 (same sign). Boxed ±(2+3i) (matches the printed key).

questions.question: Q10(e). Determine the square roots of 7 - 24i.
questions.solution: x²-y² = 7, 2xy = -24, x²+y² = 25 → 2x² = 32, x = ±4, y = ∓3. Check (4-3i)² = 16-24i-9 = 7-24i ✓. Boxed ±(4-3i) (matches the printed key).

questions.question: Q10(f). Determine the square roots of -7 + 24i.

questions.question: Q10(g). Determine the square roots of i.
